description: Burial control: does cleft-lining conservation survive when restricted to solvent-exposed residues in each clade?
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
BB={"N","CA","C","O","OXT"}
def load_pdb(fn):
    at={}
    for ln in open(fn):
        if not ln.startswith("ATOM"): continue
        i=int(ln[22:26]); a=ln[12:16].strip()
        at.setdefault(i,{})[a]=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
    return at
def sc(d):
    s=[v for k,v in d.items() if k not in BB]
    return s if s else [d["CA"]]

def annotate(fn, centre_res, cutoff=10.0):
    at=load_pdb(fn)
    cen=np.mean([np.mean(sc(at[r]),axis=0) for r in centre_res],axis=0)
    cas={r:d["CA"] for r,d in at.items() if "CA" in d}
    recs=[]
    for r,d in at.items():
        scc=np.mean(sc(d),axis=0)
        # burial = number of CA atoms within 10 A of the side-chain centroid
        nb=sum(1 for q,x in cas.items() if q!=r and np.linalg.norm(x-scc)<10.0)
        recs.append(dict(pos=r, d_cleft=min(np.linalg.norm(x-cen) for x in sc(d)),
                         nbrs=nb, cleft=min(np.linalg.norm(x-cen) for x in sc(d))<=cutoff))
    df=pd.DataFrame(recs).set_index("pos")
    df["exposed"]=df.nbrs<=df.nbrs.median()     # per-structure split, identical rule both clades
    return df

A1=annotate("AF-O62415.pdb",[64,154,157,260]); A6=annotate("AF-Q20968.pdb",[22,112,114,209])
REF1=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O62415.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
REF6=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q20968.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
M1=pd.read_csv("lys1clade_alignment_matrix.csv",index_col=0); M1.columns=[int(c) for c in M1.columns]
M6=pd.read_csv("lys6clade_alignment_matrix.csv",index_col=0); M6.columns=[int(c) for c in M6.columns]
c1=pd.Series({p:(M1[p]==REF1[p-1]).mean() for p in M1.columns})
c6=pd.Series({p:(M6[p]==REF6[p-1]).mean() for p in M6.columns})

out=[]
print("Burial control: restrict to SOLVENT-EXPOSED residues only (neighbour count below the structure median)")
for nm,cons,A,dom in [("LYS-1 clade",c1,A1,range(59,278)),("LYS-6 clade",c6,A6,range(10,215))]:
    idx=[p for p in dom if p in cons.index and p in A.index]
    e=A.loc[idx]
    for subset,lab in [(e[e.exposed],"exposed only"),(e[~e.exposed],"buried only"),(e,"all")]:
        a=cons.loc[subset.index[subset.cleft]]; b=cons.loc[subset.index[~subset.cleft]]
        if len(a)<4 or len(b)<4: continue
        u,pv=mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative="greater"); rb=2*u/(len(a)*len(b))-1
        out.append(dict(clade=nm,subset=lab,n_cleft=len(a),n_rest=len(b),
                        cleft_mean=round(a.mean()*100,1),rest_mean=round(b.mean()*100,1),
                        diff_pp=round((a.mean()-b.mean())*100,1),rank_biserial=round(rb,3),p=f"{pv:.3g}"))
T=pd.DataFrame(out); T.to_csv("cleft_conservation_burial_control.csv",index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",200); print(T.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5,4.2))
lab=[f"{r.clade}\n{r.subset}" for r in T.itertuples()]
x=np.arange(len(T))
cols=["#1f6fb2" if r.clade=="LYS-1 clade" else "#2a6f4e" for r in T.itertuples()]
ax.bar(x-0.19,T.rest_mean,0.38,color="#c4c4c4",label="rest of GH25 domain")
ax.bar(x+0.19,T.cleft_mean,0.38,color=cols,label="cleft lining")
for i,r in enumerate(T.itertuples()):
    ax.text(i+0.19,r.cleft_mean+1.5,f"+{r.diff_pp:.0f} pp\np={r.p}",ha="center",fontsize=7)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=8); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_ylabel("% identical to clade reference")
ax.set_title("The substrate groove of the catalytically dead LYS-1 clade is conserved above background, including at exposed positions",
             loc="left",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
